facts.observed: GET design export returned HTTP500 on the agents inscription draft twice
facts.serverError: invalid input syntax for type uuid: unassigned:font
facts.explanation: Font lookup casts all inscription references to uuid[] including the permitted unassigned font placeholder. This distinguishes the error from missing document-worker/provider configuration.

facts.observed: Room planning PDF saved successfully; broker switched to a temporary download tab which closed.
facts.fix: Broker now has a closed-tab fallback; it will be loaded between cohorts.

facts.observed: After the initial broker restart two repeated authentication attempts reached a common loopback-IP rate limit. Both Employee users logged in after the window; none of their goals remains blocked by it.
English native date/time widgets reproduced in a minimal HTML page without application code, despite html lang=de, Playwright locale de-DE and an additional --lang=de-DE launch.
facts.conclusion: Not counted as a confirmed app localization defect. ISO filling in the harness does not verify manual German native date entry.

facts.observed: The new-account initial password field was correctly type=password and screenshots were masked. The accessibility snapshot once echoed a newly generated synthetic initial passphrase not known to the manifest redactor.
facts.conclusion: No app plaintext-field defect inferred; no value copied into reports/events/screenshots. Broker source now collects password-field values before snapshots for redaction. Patch applied after participant interactions, not a product change.
